post.description: Extract a list of URLs asynchronously

name.description: Job name. This should be a unique identifier and will be used to modify your bulk job and retrieve its output.

urls.description: Space-delimited list of URLs to process. If you are on the Startup plan, jobs must contain at least 50 URLs.

apiUrl.description: The full Extract (or Custom) API to be used for each URL. For instance, to process each URL via the Article API, supply `https://api.diffbot.com/v3/article`. You may also include API parameters, e.g. `https://api.diffbot.com/v3/article?fields=meta,tags`.

customHeaders.description: Set custom headers to be used for processing each URL. Send multiple `customHeaders` values in your POST body, with header keys/values delimited by a colon (and URL-encoded).

notifyEmail.description: Send a message to this email address when the bulk job completes.

notifyWebhook.description: Pass a URL to be notified when the bulk job completes. You will receive a POST with a JSON response.

obeyRobots.description: Pass `obeyRobots=0` to ignore a site's robots.txt instructions.

repeat.description: Specify the number of days as a floating-point (e.g. `repeat=7.0`) to repeat this job. By default bulk jobs will not be repeated.

pageProcessPattern.description: Enter ||-separated strings to limit pages processed to those whose HTML contains any of the content strings. If a page does not contain at least one of the strings, it will be ignored.

get.description: Pause, delete, restart, or view the status of a bulk job.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Job name as defined when the bulk job was created.

parameters.name: pause
parameters.description: Pass `pause=1` to pause a bulk job. Pass `pause=0` to resume a paused job.

parameters.name: restart
parameters.description: Pass `restart=1` to restart a bulk job. This will erase all processed data and re-process all of the submitted URLs.

parameters.name: delete
parameters.description: Pass `delete=1 `to delete a job, and all associated data, completely.

get.description: Download the extracted results of a bulk job

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the bulk job whose data you wish to download.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Request `format=csv` to download the extracted data in CSV format (default: `json`). Note that CSV files will only contain top-level fields.

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: Pass an integer value (e.g. `num=100`) to request a subset of URLs, most recently processed first.

parentUrl.description: Immediate parent contained a link to this record

timestamp.description: Time when record was crawled, in ISO 8601 format.
